metadecision-31b-rain.disclosure: Re-submission on the same SHA-256-bound weights as the live metask_jev_rain_31b_trained and metask_jev_rain_31b_trained_v3 rows; only the serving code in service/ changed. Two inherited serving settings were chosen using the 231 public JevBench items: per-type temperatures in the first calibration step and the 840-token drafting-prompt limit. These choices are in-sample on the public split; the customer also used its own development data. A 50-item, two-pass determinism check had 1/50 argmax flip. The service uses a time-based 9-second drafting deadline, so answers can depend on timing. Measured on one Verda RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell 96 GB (FIN-03), the author’s own server with network access cut, using vllm/vllm-openai@sha256:a4a4c0437bf7240089da5f08aa370c4aee17ae5290f7a3b468825ee26c4c3a6b; scored elapsed time was 2,422 seconds. Engine-reported usage includes drafting/readout passes. Initial prompts: 597,680 processed tokens from 964,173 untrimmed; 5 trimmed items. The service extracts query-relevant state chunks, protects explicit rule sections, marks omissions, and uses a 6,653-token input cap; a required hard cut keeps 60% head and 40% tail.
